note: REPORT ONLY. None of these instruments can pass or fail a release.

catalogue_hide_and_recover.ci: Wilson 95% computed per file in registry/build_report_*.json
catalogue_hide_and_recover.caveat: RELIEF additions are invisible to this proxy. All SPACING arms also share removals and have additions at >=3 px, so their proxy values are identical and cannot rank the patterns. Never used as a gate or predicted-sign input.

surrogate_dti_catalogue_as_truth.caveat: The catalogue is masked pixel-exactly in live scoring, so this is a counterfactual coverage measure, not a score estimate.

leakage_canary: RELIEF bands: PASS, max AUC 0.562 (registry/leakage_canary.json). SPACING geometry: PASS, max AUC 0.4643 (registry/leakage_canary_spacing.json). Threshold 0.90; REPORT ONLY.

sgmc_control.reason: No SGMC control raster is pinned in the current data manifest. No unpinned substitute was fetched or invented.
sgmc_control.impact_on_decisions: none - report-only and no variant depends on it

block_density_cv.definition: 1 km x 1 km blocks (10 x 10 px), density = dots / footprint px per block, blocks with >=50% footprint
block_density_cv.caveat: Not comparable to the 0.51-0.59 figure quoted in the brief nor to the 0.62-0.76 reported upstream; at ~0.73 dots per block Poisson noise alone gives ~1.2. Reported, never used as a target (IRREGULARITIES.md item 6).

spacing_matched_control.why_identical: Same removals and fixed count; every added dot is >=3 px from the catalogue and therefore has zero catalogue-kernel credit. This is expected, not a duplicated raster.
